summary: Iter-12 security hardening verified end-to-end. 37/37 backend pytest cases pass covering SEC-001 (JWT 401 gate on 11 endpoints incl. /events/{id}/overview), SEC-002 (/contact owner+coach only, others 403), SEC-003 (bierwart/cashboxes/payments no longer accept spoofable actor_id/payer_id — token subject wins), SEC-004 (event hard-delete Coach-only, chat sender_id enforced from token), SEC-005 (anonymous /players returns no email/birthdate/jersey/avatar/spieler_id/password_hash while /players/full still exposes PII to authed callers), rate-limit (15/60s on login yields 429+Retry-After) and file safety (text/html upload served as application/octet-stream + Content-Disposition=attachment + X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff; /files/*/raw and /thumbnail 401 without auth). Frontend authed happy-path verified via Playwright at the preview URL: login as josh-ankermann → Termine tab loads (proves Bearer header on /events, /attendance), Team chat send appears in list, tus.token stored under AsyncStorage/localStorage, PII-stripped roster renders login picker with 'Neu' badge / lock icon only. Full storage wipe + reload correctly returns to login screen. One minor UX gap noted for main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: When the stored token is invalid (not absent) and the app is reloaded, session.tsx hydrates as 'logged in' from tus.currentPlayerId + tus.token; the first /events call returns 401 and api.ts.secureRemove clears the token, but there is no re-render / navigation back to the login screen — the tab renders a permanent spinner. In dev mode a red-screen 'API 401' overlay appears from the un-caught fetch rejection. A full second reload IS required. Consider clearing tus.currentPlayerId+tus.currentPlayer alongside the token AND triggering session state refresh (e.g. calling session.logout() or setting an auth-invalid flag consumed by _layout) so the user bounces to login without a manual second reload.

action_items: Optional: in src/api.ts, on 401 also remove tus.currentPlayerId + tus.currentPlayer and dispatch a session-invalidated event/state update so the UI navigates to login without a manual page reload. Also catch/swallow the throw in top-level fetchers (termine/chat) so no red-screen overlay is shown in dev.
No other action items — all P0/P1 security fixes verified working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: throttle uses monotonic() + per-process in-memory deque — fine for single-worker uvicorn but will not survive horizontal scaling. Acceptable for current single-pod deployment.
players.py get_players: PII fields are popped after the query; also consider excluding them at the Mongo projection layer for defence in depth.
chat.py post_message: correctly overrides body.sender_id = current_player_id BEFORE using it — verified by pytest.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (login, Termine, Chat, PII roster, full-wipe reload → login all pass; minor UX gap on invalid-token reload)

seed_data_creation: No seed data added. One transient chat message and cashbox no-op patch during tests; contact-edit tests revert their marker.

Auth key on web is localStorage['tus.token'] (JSON-encoded string), player id under localStorage['tus.currentPlayerId']. Coach = michael-moser, Bierwart cashbox recipient = sascha-grins. Rate limit is 15 login attempts / 60s per IP — flush a 65s wait between full rate-limit runs to avoid poisoning subsequent tests.
